items.title: تطور جديد في مستقبل أراوخو بين برشلونة وليفربول

items.body: لن يكون بمقدور سالم الدوسري، قائد الهلال السعودي، المشاركة مع الفريق في مباراة نيفتشي الأوزبكي ببطولة دوري أبطال آسيا للنخبة، بعد الصدمة التي تعرض لها نهاية الأسبوع الماضي. ويحل الهلال ضيفًا على نيفتشي، بعد غدٍ الإثنين، على ملعب الاستقلال في مدينة فرغانة الأوزبكية، في الجولة الخامسة من مرحلة الدوري بمجموعة الغرب ضمن منافسات دوري أبطال آسيا للنخبة. وقالت صحيفة "الرياضية" السعودية إن الإيطالي سيموني إنزاجي، المدير الفني لفريق الهلال، قرر استبعاد سالم الدوسري من القائمة التي تغادر إلى أوزبكستان، مساء اليوم السبت، لخوض المباراة الآسيوية. وأوضحت الصحيفة أن السبب في ذلك هو عدم جاهزية "التورنيدو" بشكل كامل لخوض المباراة، لا سيما بعد الرحلة الشاقة التي عاد فيها من العاصمة التايلاندية بانكوك، عقب حضور حفل جوائز الأفضل في آسيا 2026. وفور عودته، شارك سالم الدوسري في التدريبات الجماعية لفريق الهلال، اليوم السبت، وذلك في مركز الماجدية الرياضي بالعاصمة السعودية الرياض، غير أن إنزاجي قرر إراحته من رحلة بانكوك. ناقش الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة وأُقيم، أول أمس الخميس، حفل توزيع جوائز الأفضل في آسيا، وذلك على مسرح أكسرا ثياتر كينج باور بالعاصمة التايلاندية بانكوك، والذي سبق له استضافة الحفل عام 2017 أيضًا، وذلك لتوزيع الجوائز في 19 فئة مختلفة. ومن بين الجوائز التي تم توزيعها خلال…

items.title: “Race realism” isn’t realistic—and it isn’t good science
items.summary: Modern genetics does not support claims of innate racial differences in intelligence.
items.body: At this year’s World Economic Forum meeting in Davos, US President Donald Trump stated that people from Somalia have low IQs. “I always say these are low-IQ people,” he said in his speech. His son, Donald Trump Jr, made a similar statement about Haitian people in 2024 (Trump’s government has since ended the protected status of both Somali and Haitian migrants in the US). These statements and their consequences are symptoms of a growing trend in Western politics: the re-emergence of racial views of human nature that have been largely in hiding for the past 70 years. Narratives about the innate intellectual inferiority of black or brown people compared with white people—which can still be found in academic journals today—are fuelling far-right propaganda in some of the world’s largest democracies. Such claims underpin misinformation strategies on social media and bolster political movements. These narratives are sometimes euphemistically referred to as “ race science ” or more recently “race realism.” But, as we argue, they are not actually scientific. items.body: سخر خافيير تيباس، رئيس رابطة الدوري الإسباني، من فلورنتينو بيريز، رئيس ريال مدريد، عقب إعلانه عن خطة لإذاعة أبرز مباريات المسابقات الأوروبية مجانًا في الهند اعتبارًا من الموسم المقبل، معتبرًا أن رئيس النادي الملكي يتحدث باسم مؤسسات أوروبية ويكشف خططها قبل إعلانها رسميًا. ورد تيباس عبر حسابه على منصة "إكس" على تصريحات بيريز خلال اجتماع أعضاء ريال مدريد، ونشر تغريدة حملت نبرة ساخرة، قال فيها: "الآن أصبح فلورنتينو المتحدث الرسمي باسم الاتحاد الأوروبي لكرة القدم ورابطة الأندية الأوروبية وشركة يو سي 3. إنه يعلن خططهم التلفزيونية قبل أن تعلن عنها هذه المؤسسات بنفسها". وأرفق رئيس رابطة الدوري الإسباني تغريدته برمز تعبيري لشخص يضع يده على وجهه، في إشارة إلى استغرابه وسخريته من تصريحات بيريز. وجاء رد تيباس تعليقًا على إعلان رئيس ريال مدريد، الذي قال خلال كلمته أمام أعضاء النادي: "اعتبارًا من الموسم المقبل، ستصبح مشاهدة أبرز مباريات أوروبا مجانًا في الهند ممكنة من خلال منصة إلكترونية". وكان بيريز قد استعرض ضمن حديثه عن الاتفاق مع الاتحاد الأوروبي لكرة القدم ورابطة الأندية الأوروبية، المبادرات المرتقبة لتطوير بث المسابقات الأوروبية، مشيرًا إلى أن إتاحة المباريات مجانًا في الهند ستكون تجربة أولى تمهيدًا لتطبيقها في مناطق أخرى مستقبلًا. The company’s 2026 sustainability report claims that “our long-term ambitions haven’t changed, but our operating environment has,” according to an introduction from Rachel Peterson, vice president of data centers at Meta, and Blair Swedeen, global head of net zero and sustainability at Meta. In the November 19, 2026, report, they attributed the changing conditions and the need for a rethink to how “demand for AI infrastructure has grown faster than almost anyone projected.” “We are re-evaluating our timelines, sequencing, and interim milestones—including the 2030 timeframe for our net zero emissions goal and our near-term intensity targets—so our approach reflects current operating realities while keeping progress transparent year over year,” Peterson and Swedeen wrote in the report. items.title: Watching as a giant star swallowed its neighbor and exploded
items.summary: A recent brightening turned out to be from a star orbiting inside another.
items.body: In the Andromeda Galaxy, a giant star about seven times as massive as the Sun spent nearly a decade slowly swallowing its much smaller companion. The process, known as common envelope evolution, was proposed in the 1970s to explain how some of the tightest pairs of stars in the Universe form, but no one had ever caught it in the act. In a new Nature study, astronomers led by Viraj Karambelkar, an astrophysicist at Columbia University, finally witnessed the entire spectacle from the decades before it began to the eruption that ended it in late 2025. “It lasts for a few years, maybe a few decades,” Karambelkar said. “Stars evolve on time scales of millions of years. So, it's really like a blip on the entire cosmic time scale.” Shared envelopes Some pairs of stars orbit so close to each other that they could not have formed at that distance, so their orbits must have shrunk. Common envelope evolution is the leading explanation for that shrinkage. When one star in a binary grows old, it expands into a giant, and its outer layers can engulf its companion. For SpaceX's purposes, Saturday's mid-air rocket catch will help engineers learn how to rapidly reuse Starships. That should expedite SpaceX's deployment of its newest generation of Starlink Internet satellites. NASA, meanwhile, believes a higher launch cadence will lead to faster learning as SpaceX develops a deep space version of Starship to ferry astronaut crews to the surface of the Moon. Early next year, SpaceX plans to bring online a second Starship launch site at Kennedy Space Center, Florida. A second Starship factory is also under construction at Kennedy, joining SpaceX's existing SpaceX production line at Starbase, Texas. items.title: Valve says it might have to raise the price of supply-limited Steam Machines
items.summary: "We don't yet know the number we are able to make, and at what price..."
items.body: When the Steam Machine first started shipping in June , Valve said it was producing fewer units at a higher price than initially planned because it couldn't secure supplies of scarce RAM and storage components at a reasonable cost. Now, as the last of the initial batch of Steam Machine reservations are finally being fulfilled, Valve says those supply and cost issues will continue into the foreseeable future and may even require a price change. "We are continuing to build more Steam Machine units, but memory and storage costs continue to increase at unprecedented levels," Valve wrote in a blog post on Thursday . "As a result we don't yet know the number we are able to make, and at what price we'll be able to offer them. The 2TB model in particular will be especially constrained." If Valve does have to raise the price of the Steam Machine, it will be in good company. The world’s richest man has outlined ambitious plans to power AI models with data centers cooled by the vacuum of space. That will require packing satellites full of advanced chips. SpaceX has said it plans to use the chips involved in the debt deal on Earth. But lenders have expressed concerns that if the group later decided to shoot the valuable chips that underpin their loans into space, it would prevent them from reclaiming and selling the semiconductors in the event of a default, according to people familiar with the matter. items.title: Trump admin still won't let Wi-Fi giant TP-Link sell its latest routers in US
items.summary: TP-Link's struggle illustrates how Trump admin wields control over device makers.
items.body: TP-Link, which may be the top provider of wireless routers for US homes and small businesses, isn't allowed to sell its latest Wi-Fi routers in the US. The Trump administration imposed a sweeping ban on foreign-made consumer routers in March 2026, and TP-Link hasn't been able to obtain an exemption. The rules prevent the import or sale of all new router models that are manufactured, assembled, designed, or developed outside the US. The Trump administration has control over which router makers receive special permission to import and sell new products through a waiver-review process involving the Federal Communications Commission, the Department of Defense, and the Department of Homeland Security. While some of its competitors have obtained exemptions to the ban, TP-Link appears to be having a hard time making its case to government officials. Its routers approved before the March 2026 ban remain available for sale in the US, but its newly released Wi-Fi 8 routers cannot be imported or sold. Read full article Comments

items.title: MAHA PAC spent more on steak, luxury club than candidates, report shows
items.summary: Expert called MAHA's spending "pretty unusual" for a PAC.
items.body: In the wake of the Make America Healthy Again movement's midterm wipeout , a top leader suggested the heavy losses came down to being outspent by wealthier, more powerful rivals. But a Stat report on MAHA's own spending in the run-up to the election raises questions about whether the group's priority was ever winning elections in the first place. The dive into the financial documents reveals that the MAHA PAC, led by Tony Lyons, spent more on allies, boosters, meals, luxuries, and its affiliated nonprofit than it did on political candidates. The findings are in stark contrast to an announcement from Lyons in the spring that he was heading a $100 million fundraiser to boost MAHA's clout in the midterms . In reality, MAHA PAC took in $3.2 million. During the election cycle, the PAC spent more than $10.5 million, with over $7 million coming from money it had collected previously.
